comment.body:
Please provide:
1. Whether the source is Left Alt, Right Alt, or AltGr, plus the active Windows keyboard layout.
2. The exact saved Keyboard Manager remap entry, with unrelated mappings removed.
These details will show whether the unexpected Ctrl comes from AltGr semantics or from Keyboard Manager state.
